# Jill Maxwell Design-Build

> Interior design, renovations, new builds, project management, staging, and event planning across Southern Georgian Bay, Creemore, Collingwood, Toronto, and Ontario.

Jill Maxwell Design Inc. creates timeless, client-specific interiors rather than a single signature style. Jill Maxwell founded the firm in 2003 after studying History at Queen’s University and training at The International Academy of Design in Toronto. Work includes residential and commercial projects in Toronto, Mississauga, Kleinberg, Creemore, Collingwood, and Port Severn.

- Interior Design
- Renovations and New Build
